say:4:1620734001:0.source_cn: 刚刚出现的那是……难道是传说中的……

say:5:1620734002:0.text: Yes, it was the lake fairy! A creature of mystery and beauty. They say it only reveals itself to the truly lucky.
say:5:1620734002:0.source_cn: 没错，是湖中精灵！如此神秘，美丽，优雅的生灵，据说只会...

say:6:1620734003:0.text: I've been tracking it for ages. This is the first time I've ever had a chance to see it in person!
say:6:1620734003:0.source_cn: 我已经追踪湖中精灵很久了，第一次有这样难得的机会能亲眼...

say:7:1620734004:0.text: Today was incredible! I had planned to just sit in on Professor Solise's class, but before I knew it, I was flying on a Hypofiend and saw the legendary lake fairy.
say:7:1620734004:0.source_cn: 今天真是太刺激了！原本只是想去旁听娑丽丝老师的课，结果...

say:8:1620734005:0.text: I feel like a hero of an adventure story.
say:8:1620734005:0.source_cn: 简直就像变成了冒险小说的主人公一样！

say:9:1620734006:0.text: Pippa, your chaos magic is amazing.
say:9:1620734006:0.source_cn: 皮帕，你的混沌魔法太了不起了！

say:10:1620734007:0.text: Haha, thanks... Wait! I mean, don't use chaos magic again, okay...?
say:10:1620734007:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，谢谢……不对！我是想提醒你，不要再使用混沌魔法了……

say:11:1620734008:0.text: Think about it! If that flying Hypofiend weren't so tame, you'd be in real trouble! You might have fallen right out of the sky!
say:11:1620734008:0.source_cn: 你想一想，如果那只飞行魔物不是那么温顺，你的处境岂不是...

say:12:1620734009:0.text: You're not wrong... Don't worry, next time I use it, I'll be extra careful.
say:12:1620734009:0.source_cn: ……你的担心也不是没有道理，别担心，我使用的时候会加倍...

say:14:1620734010:0.text: I gotta run to my next class. See you later!
say:14:1620734010:0.source_cn: 布里奇特离开后，皮帕担忧地叹了一口气。

say:15:1620734011:0.text: After Bridger leaves, Pippa lets out a worried sigh.
say:15:1620734011:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，我怎么觉得布里奇特一点不觉得害怕，反而还很满...

say:16:1620734012:0.text: Magister Merlin, is it just me, or does Bridger seem not worried at all? If anything, he looked thrilled by the chaos magic.
say:16:1620734012:0.source_cn: 刚刚那个进入画中的女孩也是……难保他们不会再次使用混沌魔法。
say:16:1620734012:0.male: Magister Merlin, is it just me, or does Bridger seem not worried at all? If anything, he looked thrilled by the chaos magic.
say:16:1620734012:0.female: Magister Merlin, is it just me, or does Bridger seem not worried at all? If anything, he looked thrilled by the chaos magic.

say:17:1620734013:1.text: It's the same with that girl who jumped into the painting... Who knows if they'll use it again?
say:17:1620734013:1.source_cn: 对了！娑丽丝老师！我惹了这么大的麻烦还没有跟娑丽丝老师...
say:17:1620734013:1.male: It's the same with that girl who jumped into the painting... Who knows if they'll use it again?
say:17:1620734013:1.female: It's the same with that girl who jumped into the painting... Who knows if they'll use it again?

choice_prompt:18:1620734013.text: It's the same with that girl who jumped into the painting... Who knows if they'll use it again?
choice_prompt:18:1620734013.source_cn: 对了！娑丽丝老师！我惹了这么大的麻烦还没有跟娑丽丝老师说呢……以前，每次我惹出麻烦，都是娑丽丝老师在帮我解决……
choice_prompt:18:1620734013.male: It's the same with that girl who jumped into the painting... Who knows if they'll use it again?
choice_prompt:18:1620734013.female: It's the same with that girl who jumped into the painting... Who knows if they'll use it again?

say:19:1620734014:1.text: Oh right! I need to talk to Professor Solise! Every time I would get into trouble, she would swoop in to save me. I need to tell her what happened...
say:19:1620734014:1.source_cn: 那我们去找娑丽丝老师吧，刚好我也担心混沌魔法会不会在空...
say:19:1620734014:1.male: Oh right! I need to talk to Professor Solise! Every time I would get into trouble, she would swoop in to save me. I need to tell her what happened...
say:19:1620734014:1.female: Oh right! I need to talk to Professor Solise! Every time I would get into trouble, she would swoop in to save me. I need to tell her what happened...

choice:18:0:1.text: Professor Solise may have a solution.
choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 娑丽丝或许能想到办法
choice:18:0:1.male: Professor Solise may have a solution.
choice:18:0:1.female: Professor Solise may have a solution.

choice:18:1:2.text: Maybe we should check Skyrealm Forest.
choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 希望混乱不会蔓延到空境森林那边
choice:18:1:2.male: Maybe we should check Skyrealm Forest.
choice:18:1:2.female: Maybe we should check Skyrealm Forest.

narration:21:16020426:0.source_cn: 你和皮帕送布里奇特去湖边，意外目睹了“湖中精灵”的现身。
